title: System Design & Scalability
description: Master high-availability architecture principles. Learn Caching, Database Sharding, Load Balancing, Microservices, CAP Theorem, and Message Queues for campus placement interviews.
objectives: Design multi-tier caching with Redis and Memcached
Scale databases with Read Replicas, Partitioning, & Sharding
Apply CAP Theorem & Eventual Consistency in real architectures
